name: Creative Tinder draws two cards, then discards a card
notes: Creative Tinder's element is FIRE, matched by the default starting champion (Spirit of Fire), so no lineage patch is needed. Without a [Class Bonus] discount, the full 3-reserve cost is paid; completing the 3rd reserve payment cascades directly into the ability (no separate opportunity-window PASS needed for this card), which draws two cards and opens its own mandatory MZCHOOSE for which one to discard, resolved with a direct hand-card click.

rulesClauses: Draw two cards, then discard a card.
